description: Step 6 — Frontend + requirements doc + integration. Add GET /me/teams backend endpoint (TEAM_LEADER own teams / ADMIN all) to feed the create-form team selector; extend language-model-api + hook; rework LanguageModelPage (required team selector + required displayName, team/displayName columns, inline name edit, delete + confirm, ADMIN teamId edit, ADMIN PENDING management view with re-delete, QUOTA_EXCEEDED->Japanese); show displayName in TranscriptionJobForm options; update requirements.md (Japanese). Keep vitest-axe toHaveNoViolations in every touched component test. Depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-005.
steps: Backend: create <WT>/backend/src/handlers/get-my-teams.ts JSDoc 'GET /me/teams': extractUser; ADMIN -> getAllTeams(); others -> getTeamsByUserId(user.userId); successResponse({ data: teams }). Add get-my-teams.test.ts. In <WT>/infra/lib/stacks/api-stack.ts add getMyTeamsFn (DynamoDB read + KMS) and addRoute('GET','/me/teams', getMyTeamsFn, jwtAuthorizer); update api-stack snapshot.

Frontend <WT>/frontend/src/services/language-model-api.ts: add teamId+displayName to LanguageModelSummary; add teamId: string + displayName: string to CreateLanguageModelRequest; add deleteModel(modelName), updateModelName(modelName, name), updateModelTeam(modelName, teamId) via client.delete/client.patch. Add getMyTeams() (in profile-api.ts or a small typed call) returning the caller's teams for the selector. Update related service tests.

Frontend <WT>/frontend/src/hooks/useLanguageModels.ts: add deleteModel, renameModel, changeModelTeam, and reDelete (re-invoke delete on a PENDING model) actions with loading/error state and list reload on success. Update useLanguageModels.test.ts.

Frontend <WT>/frontend/src/pages/LanguageModelPage.tsx: add REQUIRED team selector (ADMIN all teams, TEAM_LEADER own teams via getMyTeams) + REQUIRED displayName input to the create form; show displayName + team column in the list; inline display-name edit mirroring components/SessionNameEditor.tsx; delete button + confirm dialog; ADMIN-only teamId edit control; ADMIN management view listing PENDING models with a re-delete affordance; map QUOTA_EXCEEDED backend errors to a Japanese message. UI text Japanese. Update LanguageModelPage.test.tsx keeping expect(container).toHaveNoViolations().
Frontend <WT>/frontend/src/components/TranscriptionJobForm.tsx: option label = model.displayName (fallback model.modelName), value stays model.modelName. Update its test incl. axe.

Docs <WT>/.kiro/specs/transcription-review-app/requirements.md (Japanese): revise Requirement 18 item 4 (COMPLETED-all -> only the caller's team's COMPLETED; ADMIN all); add to Req 18 the job-usage team check + ADMIN cross-team audit; revise Requirement 20 (required teamId/displayName, session-ownership check, within-team uniqueness, QUOTA_EXCEEDED 429); add new requirements for delete / teamId-edit / display-name-edit.
acceptance_criteria: cd <WT>/frontend && npx vitest --run passes, incl. LanguageModelPage and TranscriptionJobForm tests with expect(container).toHaveNoViolations().
cd <WT>/backend && npx vitest --run passes incl. get-my-teams.
cd <WT>/infra && npx vitest --run passes with the GET /me/teams route in the snapshot and npx cdk diff --all synthesizes cleanly.

The create form requires both a team selection (ADMIN: all teams; TEAM_LEADER: own teams) and a displayName; the model list shows displayName and team; delete, inline rename, ADMIN teamId edit, and the ADMIN PENDING re-delete view are present; a QUOTA_EXCEEDED error renders a Japanese message.
TranscriptionJobForm shows displayName as the option label while submitting modelName.
requirements.md reflects the revised Req 18/20 and the new delete/teamId-edit/display-name-edit requirements, in Japanese.
verification: cd <WT>/infra && npx vitest --run && npx cdk diff --all
findings: IMPLEMENTED Step 6 (frontend + GET /me/teams backend + requirements.md). BACKEND: new handler handlers/get-my-teams.ts (JSDoc 'GET /me/teams', named export): extractUser; isAdmin(user) -> getAllTeams(), else getTeamsByUserId(user.userId); successResponse({ data: teams }). Rationale: GET /me returns no team memberships and /admin/teams is ADMIN-only, so a TEAM_LEADER needs their own teams without admin scope. Added handlers/get-my-teams.test.ts (ADMIN all / TEAM_LEADER+REVIEWER own via getTeamsByUserId / missing sub -> 403 / repo error -> 500; mocks team-repository getAllTeams+getTeamsByUserId). INFRA: api-stack.ts added getMyTeamsFn = createLambda('GetMyTeams', { entry: handlersDir, description:'GET /me/teams - Teams available to the caller (ADMIN all / others own)', environment: commonEnv }) with grantDynamoDbRead + grantKmsAccess (read-only, placed right after getMeFn); addRoute('GET','/me/teams', getMyTeamsFn, jwtAuthorizer) right after GET /me. api-stack snapshot regenerated via `npx vitest --run test/api-stack.test.ts -u`: +218 lines / 0 deletions, limited to the GetMyTeams Lambda/Role/DefaultPolicy/LogGroup + GET /me/teams route/integration/permission (confirmed only GetMyTeams*/HttpApiGETmeteams* logical IDs added). FRONTEND API (services/language-model-api.ts): CreateLanguageModelRequest now requires teamId:string + displayName:string; LanguageModelSummary + LanguageModelRecord gained optional displayName + teamId; new LanguageModelMetadata interface; new methods deleteModel(modelName) (DELETE), updateModelName(modelName,name) (PATCH .../name {name}), updateModelTeam(modelName,teamId) (PATCH .../team {teamId}), getMyTeams() (GET /me/teams -> { data: Team[] }). New services/language-model-api.test.ts asserts path/method/body for every method incl. encodeURIComponent. FRONTEND HOOK (hooks/useLanguageModels.ts): added deleteModel(modelName)->boolean, renameModel(modelName,name)->AppError|null, changeModelTeam(modelName,teamId)->AppError|null, reDelete (alias of deleteModel for PENDING re-invoke), plus isMutating/mutationError state; all reload the list on success. Updated useLanguageModels.test.ts (new mock api methods; delete/reDelete/rename/changeTeam success+failure cases; existing createModel tests updated for required teamId/displayName). FRONTEND PAGE (pages/LanguageModelPage.tsx): create form now has a REQUIRED displayName input and a REQUIRED team selector populated from languageModelApi.getMyTeams() (ADMIN=all teams, TEAM_LEADER=own); list rows show displayName (inline-editable via components/SessionNameEditor) + modelName + resolved team name + base model + createTime; each row has a delete button with an inline confirm (role='alertdialog'); ADMIN-only 'チームを変更' control (select of teams) calls changeModelTeam and shows collision/validation errors in Japanese; a QUOTA_EXCEEDED create error maps to a Japanese quota message. PENDING re-delete: since the list endpoint excludes PENDING models and no endpoint returns them, the page tracks models whose delete returned failure (left PENDING) in local state and renders an ADMIN-only '削除保留中のモデル' management view with a '再削除' button that re-invokes reDelete; on success the entry is removed. New util utils/language-model-error.ts (describeLanguageModelError + QUOTA_EXCEEDED_MESSAGE) converts backend English errors to Japanese (QUOTA_EXCEEDED -> モデル作成上限メッセージ). Rewrote LanguageModelPage.test.tsx: access control + getMyTeams load, displayName/team columns, required-field validations (model name/displayName/team/sessions), createModel called with { modelName, baseModelName, teamId, displayName, sessionIds }, QUOTA_EXCEEDED->Japanese, delete w/ confirm + cancel, inline rename, ADMIN team change (hidden for TEAM_LEADER), PENDING re-delete affordance, status banner, and two axe (toHaveNoViolations) checks (ADMIN-with-models + access-denied). FRONTEND FORM (components/TranscriptionJobForm.tsx): model <option> label is now model.displayName ?? model.modelName while value stays model.modelName; updated TranscriptionJobForm.test.tsx (displayName labels + value=modelName, legacy fallback-to-modelName case, and a new axe toHaveNoViolations test). REQUIREMENTS (.kiro/specs/transcription-review-app/requirements.md, Japanese): Req 18 item 4 changed from 'COMPLETED all' to 'caller team COMPLETED only; ADMIN all; exclude PENDING'; item 3 now notes team scoping + Transcribe intersection; added items 6 (option label=displayName, submit modelName), 7 (job-usage team check -> 404, ADMIN any team), 8 (job-start audit languageModelName + crossTeamModelUsage flag). Req 20 extended with items 13 (required teamId + role-scoped team choices), 14 (team-exists 400 / non-member 403), 15 (required displayName trim 1-100), 16 (within-team displayName uniqueness, hide other teams), 17 (session-ownership check -> 404), 18 (QUOTA_EXCEEDED 429); item 12 audit metadata now includes teamId+displayName. Added new requirements 20A (display-name edit), 20B (teamId change / reorg, 1-model=1-team, GSI1/GSI2 rewrite, LANGUAGE_MODEL_TEAM_CHANGED), 20C (delete: targets Transcribe+DynamoDB+S3, training/in-use gates via ListTranscriptionJobs, soft->Transcribe->S3->hard order, idempotent/re-runnable PENDING recovery, LANGUAGE_MODEL_DELETED audit, confirm dialog + ADMIN PENDING re-delete). VERIFICATION: frontend `npx vitest --run` => 98 files, 1154 passed, 0 failed (incl. LanguageModelPage + TranscriptionJobForm axe toHaveNoViolations). backend `npx vitest --run` => 1252 passed / 85 skipped, 0 failed (incl. get-my-teams; one transient flake observed on one run in the large suite, not reproducible and unrelated to new code — get-my-teams passes 5/5 x3 in isolation and the suite re-run was fully green). infra `npx vitest --run` => foundation-stack (43) + api-stack (73) green; the 2 cdn-stack snapshot failures are PRE-EXISTING and UNRELATED (verified by stashing my api-stack changes and re-running cdn-stack: still 2 failed — CDK custom-resource inline-asset whitespace drift; cdn-stack.ts/test untouched by FEAT-006). `npx cdk diff --all` synthesizes cleanly (ApiStack 466 resources, GetMyTeams Lambda bundles); exit 0, live diff N/A only due to 'Unable to resolve AWS account' (no creds), same as FEAT-001..005. NOTE: getMyTeams() was added to LanguageModelApi (the plan permitted 'profile-api.ts or a small typed call') so the page has a single typed source. FEAT-*.json live under the MAIN repo .agents/tasks/...; status/findings updated there.
